summary: The Spark TP2 preset keeps its four-slot recipe on images whose vLLM lacks the new memory savings
compatibility: Applies to PRESET=glm53-spark-tp2. Images with vllm #898 are unchanged.
details: At launch the launcher reads the installed vLLM's environment names without importing it. Without VLLM_GLM53_EMBED_HOST, VLLM_GLM53_VISION_MXFP8 and VLLM_SHARE_PYNCCL_COMMS, the preset uses four request slots and 3,996 MiB of KV per rank, as before docker #87, and does not set those variables.
The same recipe builds images with different vLLM revisions; the larger KV size is safe only together with those savings.
